body.name: Proof-carrying compilation handle
body.construction: Given \(S\), \(G\), \(\rho\), \(a\), \(B\), and \(K\), exact variable elimination along a supplied bounded-width tree decomposition of the acyclic target grounding may represent messages by fraction-free univariate arithmetic circuits that preserve every type--context key and may produce the dense \(F\) together with compact local gate identities.  Under the present assignment-level interface, however, an output accepted by \(Check\) must also materialize the complete \(Ictx\) for \((\rho,a,B)\), including one record for every event-consistent complete target assignment; this last step may require exhaustive expansion.  Accordingly, this handle asserts no width-sensitive time or output bound for the present \(Ictx\) and \(Check\).  Such a guarantee requires a replacement circuit-level incidence grammar and checker.
